# Antonín Kučera — Full Profile & Capabilities

## Overview
Antonín Kučera is a Data Analytics, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and AI Specialist based in the Czech Republic.

## Expertise & Technical Focus
- **Google Cloud Platform (GCP):** BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), Dataproc (Spark), Looker, Vertex AI.
- **Data Engineering & Analytics:** dbt (data build tool), Dataform, SQL optimization, data warehouse modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines.
- **Artificial Intelligence & LLMs:** Agentic workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), generative UI, automated data pipelines powered by LLMs.
- **Business Intelligence:** Designing intuitive dashboards, metrics, and enterprise reporting.
